name: Instant RLUSD demo transfer without owner approval
description: Verifies the global transfer form settles an internal RLUSD demo payment using a recipient's registered wallet email or cell phone number.
steps: Enter a registered recipient wallet email or cell phone number and destination country
expected: The payment shows Completed (Demo), the shop balance decreases, the recipient account identified by email or phone increases and no owner approval is requested.

name: Dashboard weekly and monthly performance
covers: sales revenue and gross profit totals
description: Verifies each dashboard performance period returns a date-scoped report.
expected: Each period displays its date range, revenue, stock costs, gross profit, margin and recorded sales count.

name: Supplier payment without email
description: Verifies supplier payments complete in demo mode without supplier email details.
steps: Add a supplier using a name and country only
Choose the supplier in Accounts Payable
Pay from the demo shop account
expected: The supplier payment completes immediately and records both sides without an email address or approval queue.

name: Store RLUSD demo deposit and on-chain account status
description: Verifies a connected store XRPL address displays its validated RLUSD trust-line balance and deposit destination.
expected: The store demo account shows Available and its balance. A demo deposit debits the funding pool and credits the store. On-chain balance and trust-line status remain separate.

name: Supplier RLUSD demo payment reconciliation
description: Verifies a supplier payment in RLUSD debits the store RLUSD demo ledger and credits the selected supplier's separate RLUSD demo ledger.
steps: Open Wallet and add demo RLUSD funding to the store account
Open Suppliers and select an existing supplier
Choose RLUSD as the payment currency
Enter an amount within the available store RLUSD balance
Review the supplier's displayed RLUSD balance and payment history and the shared transaction feed
expected: The store RLUSD balance decreases by the payment amount, the supplier RLUSD balance increases by the same amount, the supplier payment history records the RLUSD payment, and the shared activity feed contains matching debit and credit records. No real tokens move.

name: International supplier contact validation
description: Checks that supplier contact details accept normal email addresses and international phone numbers with optional plus signs, spaces, brackets or hyphens.
steps: Create a supplier with email Glen@gmail.com and phone +27 82 123 4567
Edit the supplier and try an invalid email
Try a phone number with too few digits
expected: The valid contact details are accepted. Invalid non-empty email addresses and invalid international phone numbers are rejected with a clear validation message.

name: Demo card deposit credits store RLUSD ledger
description: Verifies the demo card deposit increases the store RLUSD ledger and is recorded as an RLUSD transaction without storing full card data.
steps: Enter the cardholder name, card type, final four digits and amount
Review store RLUSD balance and transaction history
expected: The store RLUSD demo balance increases by the entered amount and the shared history records an RLUSD card_deposit entry. Only the cardholder name and final four digits are retained; no card is charged.
